Name: AutoPetCare
Author: roseboyShinji
Description: so uh.. i kinda got fed up at some point with having to pat all the animals, patting just the house pet was okay, but i kinda realized that, because going out of my way to pat all my farm animals was a bit of a chore, i would always push getting a barn or coop for later when i had finished setting up everything. so.. i made a mod to deal with that instead!

Manifest.Name: AutoPetCare
Manifest.Description: Pats the animals everyday so you don't have to, and fills the pet bowl as a bonus
Manifest.Author: roseboyShinji
